visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short dark hair and a large white hair roller on her bangs stands in a brightly lit indoor room. She holds a blue and white box of Coringco Toktok Hara false eyelashes toward the camera, showing the packaging while talking. (2) The camera zooms in for a macro view of the eyelash container, revealing rows of individual lash clusters of different lengths labeled 9mm, 10mm, and 11mm. (3) The woman speaks to the camera, pointing at her eyes to explain the application method. (4) Close-up shots show her using white plastic tweezers to meticulously apply the lash clusters to her upper eyelids, followed by several angles of the finished eye makeup look.
